original_target.title: Maximal motion-planning complexity from positive simplicial volume
original_target.area: Applied topology and robot motion planning

scope_comparison: Question 5.1(b) asks maximal unreduced TC=2n+1 for positive-simplicial-volume aspherical M. The local solution to question 5.1(a), concerning weight of one zero-divisor class on a product of genus-two surfaces, does not refute (b): Example 5.7 gives maximal TC=9 for that four-manifold.

primary_sources.locator: Main theorem, positive fundamental-class norm but low weight of a specific zero-divisor
